CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 17

2. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 72

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 3

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

13. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

15. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

16. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
